groups: A gift. Let's see what's inside today.
A good fight, chief. The loot is ours. More troops will earn more stars.
A good place to check, chief.
A great hit, chief. It's getting weaker.
A hive that wants the door open? Not while I'm here.
A lock in the sky. Let's keep it shut, chief.
A monster. Check its level first, chief. Bring a big army, or team up with friends.
A new VIP level.
A new adventure today. Tap the bar, and I'll show you the way.
A new chapter of the Chronicle begins. This week's giant guards a seal. Bring it down together.
A new day, a new adventure. Follow me, chief.
A new level. Your empire grows stronger, chief.
A perfect victory, chief. Not one mistake. Open the chest.
A present for you, chief. Tap the chest.
A resource field. Send wagons here. The richer the field, the more each wagon brings home.
A rival tribe. Beat their camp for loot and experience, but check their strength first.
A scar on the seal, chief. It will take a long time to heal.
A siege tower carries our warriors right over the enemy wall. Slow, but frightening. Learn Siege Towers.
A strong blow. A few more like that, and it falls.
A strong building. Keep it growing.
A voice in the stone, chief. And she knew we would come. How long has she been waiting?
A wonder. The alliance that holds it gets a special blessing. Let's take it in the conquest phase.
A world boss is here. Only the strongest empires can bring it down.
Adventure complete. Open your treasure chest.
Air-defence teams pull planes out of the sky. Bring them when the enemy flies. Learn Guided Air Defence.
All five steps done. Your chest is waiting, chief.
All goals done.
All three goals done. You're unstoppable, chief.
An abandoned fortress is moving.
An alliance has taken the pyramid. If they hold it long enough, it's theirs.
An easy target, chief. Send the warriors, and bring home the loot.
An enemy army is coming. Bring our troops home, raise a shield, or call our friends for help.
Ancient ruins. Explore one to dig up relics, rare materials and old secrets. Oh, I love ruins. The closest ones are at the top.
Another empire. Scout before you strike, because they can strike back.
Aqueducts bring fresh water to our fields. Much more food.
Archers rain arrows on slow foot soldiers. Keep riders away from them. Learn Composite Bows.
Armoured cars race in and tear through shooters. Rifle squads can stop them. Learn Railways.
Artillery science gives us field guns. The ground will shake.
At the Army Hospital, our defenders heal and fight again.
At the Exotic Refinery, oil becomes fuel. Fill the stores before you build tanks and planes.
At the Field Hospital, our defenders heal and fight again.
At the Healer Hut, our defenders heal and fight again.
At the Herbalists’ Hall, our defenders heal and fight again.
At the Hospice, our defenders heal and fight again.
At the Hospital, our defenders heal and fight again.
At the House of Healing, our defenders heal and fight again.
At the Oil Refinery, oil becomes fuel. Fill the stores before you build tanks and planes.
At the Petrochemical Plant, oil becomes fuel. Fill the stores before you build tanks and planes.
At the Rebirth Tanks, our defenders heal and fight again.
At the Regeneration Clinic, our defenders heal and fight again.
At the Valetudinarium, our defenders heal and fight again.
Attack helicopters hover and hunt tanks anywhere. Anti-air is their enemy. Learn Rotorcraft.
Automatic weapons give us machine guns. Nobody gets past now.
Back here again. Upgrade it when you can.
Ballistics. The mathematics of throwing things very far. Catapults are next.
Bastion fortresses. Our walls become much harder to break.
Bombers flatten tanks, cannons and walls from above. Keep fighters close to them. Learn Strategic Bombing.
Boulder crews break walls from far away. Keep them behind the army, they're helpless up close. Learn Stoneworking for them.
Can't hear me? Open the menu and tap Voice check.
Cannons end the age of high walls. Keep them behind the lines. Learn Cannon Casting.
Careful, chief. Enemy scouts are watching us. Someone may attack soon.
Castle masonry gives us a mighty stone wall. Let them try to break it.
Catapults throw stones over walls from very far away. Simple mathematics, chief. Keep them behind the army. Learn Ballistics.
Chapter complete. And our story is only beginning.
Chief, the old obelisks on the map hum at night. Tap one, and listen.
Chivalry brings us knights in shining armour. Brave, and very hard to stop.
Clubmen. Tough as old roots. Riders break on them, but keep them away from slingers.
Combat robots never tire and never feel fear. A wall of metal. Learn Neural AI.
Come back every day for a gift. Events here give the best hero shards.
Come back tomorrow for three new ones.
Composite armour makes our tanks almost unbreakable. Main battle tanks are ready.
Composite bows shoot farther and harder. Our archers will be remarkable.
Counterweights power the mighty trebuchet. The heavier the stone, the farther it flies.
Craft guilds make every worker better. More of everything.
Cuirassiers ride in steel and fire at the gallop. Shooters fear them. Learn Plate Cuirass.
Deep mining reaches the metal far underground. More metal, a stronger army.
Directed energy means laser weapons. The future is here, chief.
Do this first.
Drag with one finger to explore, and pinch to zoom. Tap anything on the map, and I'll tell you what it is.
Energy shields. Our walls and soldiers glow with protection.
Engines that burn fuel. Combustion opens the Modern Age.
Eryndor, the Gate Sovereign, has stepped through.
Even the horse wears armour. Cataphracts smash through archers, but spears worry them. Learn Heavy Cavalry.
Every empire needs brave soldiers. Tap Army.
Every goal complete. Come back tomorrow, and there will be new ones.
Every level makes it better.
Every troop beats some enemies and loses to others, like rock, paper, scissors. Train a mix, and you'll win more.
Everything in our empire can grow. The Chieftain Hall is the tallest, and nothing may pass it. Tap any building, and I'll tell you its secret.
Everything is one tap away. Open the Menu.
Everything we learn here stays with us forever. Finish an age's great discovery to move to the next one.
Exosuit legionnaires. Powered armour and alien weapons. Almost nothing stops them.
Feudalism opens the Medieval Age. Castles and knights are coming.
Field guns fire fast and shake the ground. Keep them behind the army. Learn Artillery Science.
Fighters rule the sky and hunt other planes. Anti-air is their danger. Learn Powered Flight.
Five percent more attack and defence for the alliance that holds it, and its leader is crowned Sovereign.
Flawless. You have a gift for this, chief. Let's see what we won.
Food fields. Send gatherers to the closest one, and they'll carry the harvest home.
Food, wood and stone. Our buildings make them every hour, and new treasures appear in later ages.
Foraging. More food means a bigger army. An easy first lesson.
Forests for timber. We always need more wood, so keep a wagon on one of these.
Fortification makes our wall much stronger. Sleep well tonight, chief.
Four conduits rise around the Ancient Pyramid when it wakes. Destroy all four to break its shield.
Friends make us strong. Help each other build faster, and stand together against the giants.
Friends speed up your timers, send gifts, and fight giant monsters beside you.
From orbit, lances of light strike the ground. The mightiest siege of all. Learn Orbital Bombardment.
From orbit, we can strike anywhere. The final siege.
From the Deep-Space Array, I see who's marching toward us.
From the Hill Beacon, I see who's marching toward us.
From the Lighthouse, I see who's marching toward us.
From the Lookout, I see who's marching toward us.
From the Observation Tower, I see who's marching toward us.
From the Observatory, I see who's marching toward us.
From the Radar Station, I see who's marching toward us.
From the Renaissance Age on, five Ancient Elementals tear through the rifts in the sky. Defeat all five within two days, and the Convergence forms.
From the Sensor Spire, I see who's marching toward us.
From the Signal Tower, I see who's marching toward us.
From the Watchtower, I see who's marching toward us.
Giant monsters and great events are listed here. Check before you march.
Good to see you, chief. I missed you. The city has been busy.
Grav tanks glow inside a shield of light. The strongest riders of all. Learn Gravitic Armour.
Gravitic armour wraps our tanks in shields of light.
Gravity drives. This is the key to the Space Age. To the stars, chief. I always knew we'd go.
Guards, not monsters. I'll remember that when we fight them.
Guided air defence knocks planes out of the sky. The sky is ours.
Guided munitions almost never miss. Rocket artillery, and harder hits for everyone.
Gunpowder changes everything. Our musketeers are ready.
Hear the wheels? Chariots hit hardest in the first crash. Archers fear them, spears stop them. Learn The Wheel.
Heavy artillery. Howitzers fire over hills from far away.
Heavy cavalry. Armour for horse and rider. Archers will run.
Heavy javelins break shield walls. Our javelineers are waiting.
Hello, chief. Can you hear me?
Hello, chief. I'm Hypatia. These ruins hold a power older than any empire. Together, we'll take our people from the Stone Age to the stars.
Heroes grow too. Every battle we lead makes us stronger. Tomes of Tactics give a quick boost.
Hill forts make our wall tougher, and our defenders braver.
Hound packs run slingers down in a heartbeat, but a wall of clubmen stops them. Learn Domestication to train them.
Hover tanks float over water, sand and swamp. Fast and fierce. Learn Repulsor Lift.
Hundreds of cubes are coming together.
Hundreds of tiny drones, moving like one mind. They swarm planes and tanks. Learn Swarm Intelligence.
I can hear it too now. One, and one, and one. Like counting.
Iron tools make every worker faster. More wood, more stone, more metal.
Iron warriors. The backbone of any army. Riders bounce off them, but watch for javelins.
Iron, and the steel of the old builders. This is the key to the Iron Age.
It falls from orbit onto plains, desert or forest about every four hours, and stays about three. Every empire nearby is in danger, so rally your alliance.
It was too strong for us, chief. Train a bigger army first.
Its last message is gone into the dark, and the great doors stand open.
Its shield is down. Now, chief. Attack now.
Javelineers throw spears heavy enough to break shield walls. Keep riders off them. Learn Javelins.
Knights. Shining armour and a charge that shatters archers. Pikes are their danger. Learn Chivalry.
Know your enemy, chief. Here is every giant, where it lives, and when it strikes.
Knowledge is power, chief. Tap Research. It's my favourite place.
Laser troopers hit at the speed of light, even planes. Keep fast vehicles off them. Learn Directed Energy.
Legionnaires. Disciplined, armoured, brave. They hold any line against riders.
Let's cast cannons. No wall will stand against us now.
Let's make it even bigger.
Let's tame the wild beasts. Hound packs, fast enough to hunt slingers.
Line infantry, rifles and bayonets. Steady and brave, and riders hate them.
Logistics lets us carry more loot and send out one more army. Planning wins wars.
Longbowmen shoot farther than anyone. Their arrow storms crush foot soldiers. Learn Longbows.
Longbows shoot farther than anything we've had. Our archers will rule the field.
Look at our village grow, chief. There's a chest for you.
Look how far we've come, chief. Another level.
Look out. The Orbital Devourer has landed. It won't stay long, so call your friends and strike fast.
Lost? Don't worry. Tap here to fly home.
Machine gunners pin the enemy down, and can even hit low planes. Learn Automatic Weapons.
Main battle tanks. Thick armour and a gun that almost never misses. Learn Composite Armour.
Mass production. We train soldiers much faster, and make more alloy.
Food from the Bio-Dome Farms feeds us all. Grow it as the army grows.
Food from the Collective Farms feeds us all. Grow it as the army grows.
Food from the Estate Farms feeds us all. Grow it as the army grows.
Food from the Foraging Grounds feeds us all. Grow it as the army grows.
Food from the Hydroponic Towers feeds us all. Grow it as the army grows.
Food from the Iron-Plough Fields feeds us all. Grow it as the army grows.
Food from the Irrigated Fields feeds us all. Grow it as the army grows.
Food from the Manor Farms feeds us all. Grow it as the army grows.
Food from the Mechanised Farm feeds us all. Grow it as the army grows.
Food from the Villa Estates feeds us all. Grow it as the army grows.
Mechanization brings tanks. Rolling steel for our army.
Men-at-arms hold a castle gate like a rock. Riders can't break them, but arrows can.
Monsters drop forge materials and teach your hero. If our army is small, pick one marked Easy.
Monsters drop special materials. Bring them here, and we'll forge gear for your hero.
More bonuses unlocked for your empire.
Morvath, the Hollow King, has risen.
Musketeers punch through armour with every volley. Keep cavalry away from them. Learn Gunpowder.
My voice can't reach you in this browser view, so you'll see my words instead. Open the game in Chrome or Safari to hear me.
Next time, chief. Build a bigger army first, and they won't stand a chance.
Nicely done. Our adventure keeps going.
Nobody wins alone, chief. Tap Alliance.
None alive right now. It will return.
Not active. They appear when the pyramid wakes.
Not in our skies. I'll warn you the moment it comes down.
Not this time. It's all right, chief. Train more troops, and we'll try again.
Now let's see the great world beyond our walls. Tap World.
OMEGA-0 has rebuilt its defence drones.
OMEGA-0, the First Cube, has assembled.
Oil fields fuel our tanks and aircraft. Claim them before our rivals do.
One more step. The chest is getting closer.
One of the five seals of the Convergence. Break its radiant barrier.
One of the five seals of the Convergence. Destroy its emerald nodes.
One of the five seals of the Convergence. Disable its storm nodes.
One of the five seals of the Convergence. Keep striking it before solar overload.
One of the five seals of the Convergence. Neutralise its gravity anomalies.
One of the seals is getting weak, chief. Beat the Hive near the wonders to make it strong again.
One step done. On to the next, chief.
Only the leading hero's powers count in battle. Choose the right hero for each fight.
Ore for metal. Stronger troops and gear need it, so gather it whenever you can.
Other empires. Scout them before you attack, and remember, they can strike back.
Our first real cavalry. Horsemen are quick and crush archers, but steady warriors hold them. Learn Horse Breeding.
Our hall grew. A town chest is waiting.
Pathfinding helps our armies march faster and see farther. Every map starts with a curious mind.
Paved roads. Faster marches, and bigger loads of loot.
Phalanx drill teaches our troops to fight as one, and unlocks new formations.
Philosophy opens the Classical Age. Big ideas, for a big empire. I've waited for this one.
Plan great battles here. Always scout first, then strike where they're weakest.
Plasma lances melt armour and knock planes from the sky. Learn Plasma Weapons.
Plasma weapons melt anything they touch. Our lancers are ready.
Plate armour for our riders. Cuirassiers charge with pistols blazing.
Quests, daily goals and trophies. Anything with a red badge is a reward. Collect them all.
Quick buttons are on top, and every screen is below. Tap your ruler card to see your profile.
Radar sees everything coming. Our defence gets stronger, and we see farther.
Raid the Rival Tribe for loot.
Railguns fire faster than sound.
Railguns fire metal faster than sound, over the horizon. Learn Railguns to build them.
Railways. Faster marches, and fast armoured cars too.
Repulsor lift makes tanks float. Hover tanks can go anywhere.
Rewards are waiting. Anything with a red badge is ready, so tap and collect.
Rifle squads carry everything, even weapons that stop tanks. A strong, steady heart for any army.
Rifling makes our guns shoot straight and far. Sharpshooters, take aim.
Rival tribes guard loot. Beat their camp to grow stronger, but check the badge first: Easy, Fair or Hard.
Rock fields give stone for walls and upgrades. Pick the nearest and tap Go.
Rocket launchers cover a whole field in fire. Keep them far behind the army. Learn Guided Munitions.
Rotorcraft. Helicopters that hover, and hunt tanks.
Scorpion crews fire bolts that punch through armour. Keep riders off them. Learn Torsion Engines.
See the green arrow? That building is ready to grow. Tap it.
Sharpened palisades. Our wall gets tougher, and raiders get a nasty surprise.
Sharper flint means harder blows. Our foot soldiers get stronger.
Sharpshooters hit targets from far away, even low planes. Watch for fast vehicles. Learn Rifling.
Siege towers roll our warriors over enemy walls. Clever, and strong.
Siegecraft gives us battering rams. No wall is safe now.
Slingers strike before the lines even meet. Deadly to foot soldiers, afraid of fast riders. Learn Slings to train them.
Slings. Our first soldiers who fight from a distance. You'll like them.
Smelting makes better weapons, so every soldier hits harder.
So that's why the wonders feel special. We'll guard them.
Solkaris's wheel is fully charged. Its beam burns twice as hard, and its light shields it. Keep striking to break the charge.
Solkaris, the Sun Devourer, has come down.
Something huge just arrived on the map. Let's go and see.
Spearmen. Shields locked together, and no rider gets through. Only arrows worry them.
Special forces. The best we have. Quiet, quick, and they carry missiles that stop tanks.
Speed-ups are best when every builder and scholar is busy. Spend them wisely, chief.
Starfighters with crystal engines. Faster than lightning.
Starfighters. Crystal engines, and speed like lightning. Learn Starfighters to build them.
Stealth jets slip past every radar.
Stealth jets slip past radar and strike before anyone sees them. Learn Stealth Airframes.
Steam power. Hear the engines roar? This opens the Industrial Age.
Stoneworking brings more stone, and boulder crews that break walls.
Strategic bombing gives us bombers. Watch the sky.
Strong horses for real cavalry, and faster marches for everyone.
Strong steel protects every soldier. Our whole army gets tougher.
Supply caches. Fly to one and tap it to claim free resources.
Swarm intelligence teaches drones to hunt together, like birds in the evening sky.
Tanks. Rolling steel that crushes shooters. Clever infantry with rockets is their worry. Learn Mechanization.
Tap Missions. This is where the treasure is.
Tap a picture to see the nearest ones, then press Go, and I'll take you there. Easy, Fair and Hard tell you how tough a target is.
Tap anywhere to hear me.
Ten ages, from stone tools to starships. Every age brings new buildings and new troops.
Tharok's armour is cracking open. Its burning core is showing. Strike now, before the stone closes.
Tharok's stone armour has closed over its core again.
Tharok, the Worldbreaker, has torn itself out of the mountains.
That camp is weak. Send our warriors, and bring home the loot.
That's a whole chapter done. I'm proud of you, chief.
That's you. Pick an avatar, write a few words about yourself, and see how you rank. Other rulers see this card when they tap your banner.
The Academy. What we learn here, no one can take.
The Aggregate Works. Walls and halls are hungry for stone.
The Air Base. Our wings. Just beware of enemy anti-air.
The Airfield. Our wings. Just beware of enemy anti-air.
The Alien Forge. Alloy for tanks and great machines. We'll need plenty.
The Ancient Pyramid is waking. It was never a tomb, chief. It's a machine, and it's standing up. Defeat it to open the doors.
The Ancient Pyramid's last defender. It rises during the siege, after the four Energy Conduits fall.
The Ancient Pyramid. The heart of everything. When it wakes, it will take every army we have.
The Archaeologists’ Guild. What we dig up here opens the next age.
The Architects. I wonder what they were like. I wonder if they looked at the same stars.
The Army Depot, where our people become soldiers.
The Asteroid Ore Relay. Strong soldiers are made of its metal.
The Automated Mill. Almost everything starts as wood.
The Autonomous Mine. Strong soldiers are made of its metal.
The Awakened Pyramid has fallen.
The Awakened Pyramid has raised its glyph pylons again.
The Barracks, where our people become soldiers.
The Biomass Foundry. Almost everything starts as wood.
The Bronze Age. Can you feel it?
The Bronze Citadel, our heart. Raise it, and the rest can rise.
The Bunker Line keeps our people safe. Keep it growing.
The Cabinet of Curiosities. What we dig up here opens the next age.
The Carpentry Works. Almost everything starts as wood.
The Castle Keep, our heart. Raise it, and the rest can rise.
The Chieftain Hall is bigger. Open your town chest.
The Chieftain Hall, our heart. Raise it, and the rest can rise.
The Classical Age. Can you feel it?
The Copper & Tin Mine. Strong soldiers are made of its metal.
The Curtain Wall keeps our people safe. Keep it growing.
The Data & AI Lab. What we learn here, no one can take.
The Deep Iron Mine. Strong soldiers are made of its metal.
The Delvers’ Camp. What we dig up here opens the next age.
The Dig Site. What we dig up here opens the next age.
The Druids’ Grove. What we learn here, no one can take.
The Eclipse hurt us, chief. But we're still standing.
The Eclipse is here, chief. Every seal counts now.
The Energy Barrier keeps our people safe. Keep it growing.
The Excavation Terraces. What we dig up here opens the next age.
The Excavation Works. What we dig up here opens the next age.
The Exo-Legion Bastion, where our people become soldiers.
The Fabrication Hub. Alloy for tanks and great machines. We'll need plenty.
The Field Headquarters, our heart. Raise it, and the rest can rise.
The Flint Pit. Walls and halls are hungry for stone.
The Forum Palace, our heart. Raise it, and the rest can rise.
The Gallery Mine. Strong soldiers are made of its metal.
The Garrison Barracks, where our people become soldiers.
The Hill-Fort Hall, our heart. Raise it, and the rest can rise.
The Hill-Fort Rampart keeps our people safe. Keep it growing.
The House of Scribes. What we learn here, no one can take.
The Imperial Mines. Strong soldiers are made of its metal.
The Industrial Age. Can you feel it?
The Institute of Science. What we learn here, no one can take.
The Iron Age. Can you feel it?
The Iron Command Hall, our heart. Raise it, and the rest can rise.
The Iron Mine. Strong soldiers are made of its metal.
The Iron Redoubt keeps our people safe. Keep it growing.
The Iron-Tool Quarry. Walls and halls are hungry for stone.
The Legion Fort, where our people become soldiers.
The Logging Camp. Almost everything starts as wood.
The Lumber Works. Almost everything starts as wood.
The Marble Quarry. Walls and halls are hungry for stone.
The Masons’ Quarry. Walls and halls are hungry for stone.
The Matter Compactor. Walls and halls are hungry for stone.
The Medieval Age. Can you feel it?
The Military Base, where our people become soldiers.
The Modern Age. Can you feel it?
The Mudbrick Wall keeps our people safe. Keep it growing.
The Orbital Launch Complex. Our wings. Just beware of enemy anti-air.
The Ore Combine. Strong soldiers are made of its metal.
The Palazzo, our heart. Raise it, and the rest can rise.
The Palisade keeps our people safe. Keep it growing.
The Planetary Command Spire, our heart. Raise it, and the rest can rise.
The Planetary Shield keeps our people safe. Keep it growing.
The Precursor Archive. What we dig up here opens the next age.
The Pyramid Overlord has risen, its last guardian. We'll need every army we have.
The Recovery Bunker. What we dig up here opens the next age.
The Renaissance Age. Can you feel it?
The Research Bureau. What we learn here, no one can take.
The Robotic Quarry. Walls and halls are hungry for stone.
The Royal Capital. Hold it, and your alliance leader becomes Sovereign. It opens in the conquest phase.
The Sawmill. Almost everything starts as wood.
The Scholars’ College. What we learn here, no one can take.
The Shaft Mine. Strong soldiers are made of its metal.
The Shaman Lodge. What we learn here, no one can take.
The Space Age. Can you feel it?
The Star Fort keeps our people safe. Keep it growing.
The Steam Quarry. Walls and halls are hungry for stone.
The Steam Sawmill. Almost everything starts as wood.
The Steelworks. Alloy for tanks and great machines. We'll need plenty.
The Stone Age. Can you feel it?
The Stone Quarry. Walls and halls are hungry for stone.
The Stone Rampart keeps our people safe. Keep it growing.
The Stonecutters’ Yard. Walls and halls are hungry for stone.
The Strategic Nexus, our heart. Raise it, and the rest can rise.
The Tank Factory. Alloy for tanks and great machines. We'll need plenty.
The Temple of the Ruin. What we dig up here opens the next age.
The Tercio Barracks, where our people become soldiers.
The Timber Yard. Almost everything starts as wood.
The Training Complex, where our people become soldiers.
The University. What we learn here, no one can take.
The War Camp, where our people become soldiers.
The Warrior Hall, where our people become soldiers.
The Water-Powered Sawmill. Almost everything starts as wood.
The Woodcutters. Almost everything starts as wood.
The World War Age. Can you feel it?
The Xeno-Archaeology Lab. What we dig up here opens the next age.
The Xeno-Science Spire. What we learn here, no one can take.
The battering ram knocks walls flat, but it can't fight back. Guard it well. Learn Siegecraft.
The battlefield falls silent.
The builders are at work. Watch the timer. Short jobs can finish for free, and friends can help.
The fallen rise again around Morvath, the Hollow King. His ghostly guard has returned.
The giant has fallen. Open its treasure.
The ground is splitting.
The howitzer fires over hills from far away. Enormous damage, but it needs protecting. Learn Heavy Artillery.
The machine at the heart of the world. It wakes in stages: conduits rise, its shield falls, the Overlord fights, and the alliance that holds it last claims its power.
The printing press. Knowledge for everyone, everywhere. It opens the Renaissance, and I could cry.
The pyramid has been conquered. Its power belongs to the winners, for now.
The pyramid is open. The first alliance to hold it gets its power. Hurry, chief.
The pyramid is waking up, chief. Four glowing towers rise around it. Break all four, and its shield falls.
The radar shows us in gold, friends in green, rivals in red. Zoom with plus and minus, or tap the circle to fly home.
The scientific method. Ask, test, learn. We'll study everything faster now. Wise choice, chief.
The seal cracked. We'll be stronger next time, chief.
The seal held, chief. The Chronicle will remember this.
The sky is cracking open.
The sky is going dark.
The sun is going dark, chief. Hold the seals.
The symbols in the ruins are starting to make sense, chief. I can almost read them. We'll dig up alien pieces faster.
The trebuchet throws boulders and fire across the whole battlefield. A beautiful machine. Learn Counterweights to build it.
The wheel. Such a simple idea, and it changes everything. Faster marches, and war chariots.
The wonders of the world. Alliances fight to hold them for their blessings.
There you are. I can speak again, chief.
There's a weak camp nearby. Let's go and win some loot, chief.
They were stronger than us today. We'll train more soldiers and come back.
Thinking machines. Neural AI unlocks combat robots, and a whole new path. I wonder what they dream about.
This is the Finder. It finds food, wood, monsters, tribes and treasure, closest first.
This is the Finder. Tap a picture to find the closest ones, then press Go, and I'll take you there.
This is the big one, chief. Learn Bronze Working, and lead our people into the Bronze Age.
This strip shows what everyone is doing: builders, scholars and armies. Tap any of them to go straight there.
Three stars, and not a scratch on us. Open the chest.
Tiny chips with enormous power. Microelectronics opens the Information Age.
To the stars, then. And we'll take her with us.
Today's adventure is ready, chief. Shall we?
Too strong for us, for now. Grow the army, and we'll come back.
Torsion engines. Twisted rope that throws giant bolts. Our scorpions are waiting.
Train soldiers here. Each kind beats some enemies and loses to others. Tap any troop, and I'll tell you its strengths.
Treasure. Glowing supply boxes appear near our land. Tap one to claim it.
Upgrading makes a building stronger, and unlocks new ones. Tap Upgrade.
Varkhoss is putting out gun turrets. Destroy them to strip its defences.
Varkhoss, the Iron Cataclysm, has unfolded.
Victory. Nobody will forget this battle.
Victory. Open the chest. A bigger army next time means more stars.
War chants. They put fire in our warriors, and unlock our first battle doctrines.
Warden Hearts. They were holding back the end. Let's use them well.
We brought it down. What a victory, chief.
We can fly, chief. Powered flight gives us fighter planes. People dreamed of this for thousands of years.
We couldn't even scratch it, chief. We need more soldiers.
We did it. Come and open the adventure chest.
We finally understand the builders of the ruins, chief. Everything we have grows stronger. I've waited my whole life for this.
We hurt it. Keep the attacks coming.
We made it to the stars, chief. Open the Chronicle. Our story goes on.
We survived the Eclipse, chief. The door held.
We will rise through ten ages, from stone to the stars. To advance, finish the age's key research, dig fragments at the Dig Site, and raise the Chieftain Hall.
We won't go out, chief. Not this time.
We won, chief. Open the chest. Bring more troops next time, and we'll earn all three stars.
We're growing so fast. A new level, and new rewards.
Welcome back. The city kept working while you were away.
